'''Seismic EMP countermines''' were [[Mine/Legends|mines]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to neutralize space mines. During the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Battle of Duro]], they were deployed by [[Techno Union picket ships]]. The countermines cleared a corridor into [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] precipitating the attack.
